name: Head-height catch
why: Keepers catch high balls. Practise catching in front of your face.

setup.space: A clear 2 m square for the keeper. Move breakables away. The parent stands about 3 m away.
setup.equipment: Goalkeeper gloves and a soft or light ball. Indoors, use a soft ball.
setup.parent: Stand about 3 m away. Wait until the keeper is set. Toss gently to head height.

steps: Put on goalkeeper gloves. Face the parent and get set.
The parent tosses gently to head height.
Catch in front of your face. Keep your hands behind the ball and thumbs close.
Freeze with the ball. Then return it to the parent.

mistakes.fix: Catch in front of your face.
Bring your thumbs behind the ball.

parent_check: Ball caught in front of the face, not against the chest
Thumbs behind the ball during the freeze
stop_if: Pain in a hand, wrist or finger
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath

easier.variant: Catch a gentle toss at chest height.
easier.use_when: The head-height catch is not clean.

harder.variant: Catch a gentle toss just above head height.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean at 2 x 15, two sessions in a row. Then the owner approves.
